He folded the note carefully, slipped it into his coat pocket, and climbed the spiral stairs to radio the mainland.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像一头沉睡的巨兽，只剩下微弱的呼吸。街灯把橘黄色的光洒在空旷的马路上，偶尔一辆出租车驶过，轮胎碾过积水发出细碎的声响。早点铺的灯已经亮了，老板娘揉着惺忪的眼揪下一团面，蒸笼里白雾升腾。环卫工人的扫帚划过人行道，沙沙声像大地在低语。远处工地的塔吊亮着红灯，高楼的轮廓模糊在夜色与晨曦的交界处。这座城市还没有醒来，却已经有人在为它的苏醒做准备。一切寂静而忙碌，属于少数人的四点钟。", "w03": "• Recursion is when a thing solves a problem by using a smaller version of itself — like looking up a word in the dictionary and finding the definition uses another word you also need to look up.\n• Every recursive thing needs a stopping point (called a base case), otherwise it would keep going forever, like two mirrors facing each other.\n• So a recursive recipe has two parts: the simple case you already know the answer to, and the step where you shrink the problem and ask yourself the same question again with the smaller piece."}
